answer: What survives to the bridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the atlas of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the walnut re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
